annotations.text:
Take On Me, broken down as 2 Juno-60 layers and 3 DX7 layers.

No timeline anywhere. Three ways to answer the same two questions: what is each synth doing, and how is it set up.

Colour means the instrument, never the layer. Layers are named in place.

Option A is the full page: click a layer in the rack, the panel below it changes.

B and C are the alternates. The LEDs in A take a layer out of the mix so you can see the gap it leaves.

Say which one to build out and I will fold the other two in or drop them.
